overview_description.description: Brainbase is a provider of enterprise management software solutions to the club, leisure fitness and sports, foodservice, construction, attractions, metal service centres, moving and storage, education, radiology and laboratory information systems, and consumer product licencing industries. Brainbase combines every element needed to run a global licensing business at scale, allowing your team to make smarter, faster decisions.
